Surrey acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more, from the MLS®. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.
Surrey market context, June to September 2026

Surrey had 1,120 houses and 1,523 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 84 and 114 sold in the month. Acreages are a smaller part of those listings, so the market-wide figures below are the closest published read on the price pressure around them.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

blocks.text: Before you buy acreages in Surrey
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: Is Surrey a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Surrey had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Surrey?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Surrey that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in Surrey?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Surrey homes?
faq.a: The Surrey homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Surrey market stats page has the monthly figures.
